---
title: "Publications"
description: "A live feed of my research output, pulled automatically from Zotero. Updated every two weeks."
page-layout: full
# Listing page: the share buttons in this directory's _metadata.yml are meant
# for the detail pages, not this index.
share: false
toc: false
# One listing per publication type, journal articles first, so the strongest
# work reads as a section rather than as a row somewhere in a date-sorted
# wall. Same pattern cv.qmd uses. Types with no entries render an empty
# section, which the `:has()` rule in theme.scss hides — so a new Zotero item
# type can never fall off this page.
listing:
  - id: pubs-journal
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Journal Article"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-preprint
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Preprint"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-thesis
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Thesis"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-book
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Book"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-chapter
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Book Chapter"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-report
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Report"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-presentation
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Presentation"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-webinar
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Webinar"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-media
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Media Coverage"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-review
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Peer Review"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-other
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Publication"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script src="../assets/home.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<!-- The numbers are fallbacks: scripts/update-stats.ts rewrites them at render
     time from the publications/*/index.qmd frontmatter, so they can't drift as
     the Zotero sync adds entries. The citations block is dropped entirely when
     no entry carries a `pub-citations` count yet. -->
<div class="nw-stats nw-pubstats">
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-total">30</b><span>Publications &amp; Talks</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-journal">5</b><span>Journal Articles</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-first">12</b><span>First-Author Works</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat" data-nw-stat-block="pub-citations"><b data-nw-stat="pub-citations">14</b><span>Citations</span></div>
</div>
```
